author: Pensar
description: AI-powered penetration testing CLI tool with terminal UI
name: @pensar/apex

scripts.build: rm -rf build && bun build src/cli.ts --outdir build --target node --format esm --splitting --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/react --external @opentui/react/* --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external react-reconciler --external weave --external electron --external chromium-bidi --external camoufox-js
scripts.build:binaries: bun run generate:ascii && mkdir -p dist && bun run build:binary:macos-arm64 && bun run build:binary:macos-x64 && bun run build:binary:linux-x64 && bun run build:binary:linux-arm64
scripts.build:binary: bun run generate:ascii && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --external electron --external chromium-bidi --external camoufox-js --outfile pensar
scripts.build:binary:linux-arm64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --external electron --external chromium-bidi --external camoufox-js --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/pensar-linux-arm64
scripts.build:binary:linux-x64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --external electron --external chromium-bidi --external camoufox-js --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/pensar-linux-x64
scripts.build:binary:macos-arm64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --external electron --external chromium-bidi --external camoufox-js --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/pensar-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:binary:macos-x64: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --external electron --external chromium-bidi --external camoufox-js --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/pensar-darwin-x64
